summary: First full E2E run after the Supabase -> MariaDB migration (TanStack Start app on :3000, tested through the public URL). One CRITICAL blocker was found and fixed by the testing agent: every catalog/offer query failed with 'Illegal mix of collations (utf8mb4_unicode_ci vs utf8mb4_general_ci)'. That meant no offers on the home page, category pages or search, and offer pages returned 500. After the fix these work: login (wrong password error, httpOnly+Secure cookies, lockout after 5 failed tries), signup, catalog, offer page, search, seller page, the BuyBox (option, qty, Card enabled, PayPal/Razorpay/Crypto disabled with 'Not set up', logged-out Buy redirects to /auth, required-field validation), a real redirect to checkout.stripe.com (test mode, 3 times), the signed Stripe webhook -> paid/auto-delivered codes, /checkout/return -> /orders/<id>, buyer orders list and detail (chat, confirm received, dispute), reviews (only for the buyer's completed order; the review appears on the seller page with stars), the seller cabinet (dashboard stats, create and edit offer incl. options, orders, manual deliver, review reply, payout request incl. insufficient-balance error), buyer blocked from /cabinet and /admin, and the admin panel (dashboard stats, orders search/filter, Refund/Cancel buttons, user status change, offer status, categories create/edit/delete, review hide/show, payout mark paid, settings save with 'keys missing in .env' for paypal/razorpay/crypto). Two CRITICAL issues remain: (1) LOGOUT IS BROKEN: only the last Set-Cookie header reaches the browser, so juj_at survives logout. (2) MULTI-LANGUAGE IS NOT IMPLEMENTED: every i18n/*.json is an empty {} and content_translations has no rows for seeded offers or categories. Switching language only changes lang/dir (ar=rtl works); all UI text and offer titles stay English.

critical.issue: Only the LAST Set-Cookie header is emitted, even by the Node server itself on localhost:3000 (verified with curl: login returns only juj_rt; logout returns only the juj_rt deletion). juj_at is never deleted on logout, so the user stays logged in (Profile menu still shows Log out and /orders still works) until the 15-min access token expires. Login only appears to work because a later request re-issues juj_at from juj_rt. Fix: issue a single session cookie, or make sure several Set-Cookie headers survive the dev/SSR adapter (e.g. 2 server fns, or clear juj_at in a 2nd call, or use one combined cookie). Then retest logout.

ar/fr/es/ru/zh/ko/id dictionaries are all '{}'. content_translations has only rows for offer 41, which the tester created. Seeded offers and categories have NO translations. The user-requested multi-language UI plus translated offer titles/descriptions is missing. The translation helper (POST 127.0.0.1:8001/api/internal/translate) works when called directly (fr/ar returned correctly). Fill the UI dictionaries and run the translation for all seeded offers and categories (scripts/translate_content.py or the admin 'Re-translate' button).

FIXED BY TESTER: charset 'utf8mb4' makes mysql2 use utf8mb4_general_ci on the connection. CAST(o.id AS CHAR) in OFFER_TR then compared against utf8mb4_unicode_ci columns -> 'Illegal mix of collations'. All offer listings/details failed (home 'Loading offers...' forever, offer page 500). Changed to charset: 'UTF8MB4_UNICODE_CI' and restarted the frontend. Please keep this change and make sure database/juj.sql / prod config use the same collation.

minor.issue: Its validator passes raw input through: validator((d) => d). It is validated later in leaveReview via reviewSchema.parse, but zod errors leak as raw messages. Use reviewSchema in .validator for consistency.
Trusts the first X-Forwarded-For value, which the client controls. This lets someone bypass the per-IP limit (20/15min). The per-email lockout (5) works.
Every transactional email to the *.test seed users fails with 422 'Undeliverable recipient' (expected for demo domains, but it fills the logs).

Seller rating_count / sales_count are fake large numbers (e.g. KeyForge '612 reviews' while there are 6 real reviews). New reviews are averaged into the fake count. Seller 'Earned: $51.16' while balance is $0 for the seeded completed orders.
When fetchOffers throws, the catalog/home grid shows 'Loading offers…' forever instead of an error state.

ui_bugs.issue: User remains logged in after logout (see backend critical #1)

Switching to ar sets <html dir=rtl lang=ar>, but the text stays English. The same happens for fr/es/ru/zh: the Buy button, labels and offer h1 are untranslated. In one run, [data-testid=language-ko] was not found after 5 consecutive switches (possibly flaky, menu re-render after reload).

Once rendered a completely blank main area (no panel) on page.goto after several admin navigations. A direct load works, and Save shows 'Saved'. Intermittent, possibly SSR error on access-cookie refresh.

issues: Release/Refund/Cancel, category delete, review delete and payout reject use the browser's native confirm()/prompt(). Use a shadcn AlertDialog/Dialog instead.
Missing data-testids: seller verification select, admin offer status select, category Edit/Delete, review Hide/Delete, payout Reject
'Confirm received' releases money with a single click and no confirmation dialog
Search input is squeezed to ~80px; the placeholder is cut off ('Searcl')

action_items: CRITICAL: Fix logout. Only the last Set-Cookie survives, so juj_at is never cleared. Use a single session cookie, or otherwise make sure both cookies are deleted, then verify at the browser level.

CRITICAL: Implement the translations: fill src/i18n/{ar,fr,es,ru,zh,ko,id}.json and populate content_translations for all seeded offers and categories (run the translate script or the admin re-translate).
Keep the db.server.ts charset fix (UTF8MB4_UNICODE_CI). Also add an error state to the offer grids instead of an infinite 'Loading offers…'.
Replace native confirm()/prompt() in the admin panel with AlertDialog; add the missing data-testids listed above.
Update /app/memory/test_credentials.md: it still says auth is Supabase; it is now local MariaDB.
critical_code_review_comments: db.server.ts: the pool is cached on globalThis, so changing the pool config needs a frontend restart (hot reload won't apply it).
orders.server.openDispute updates status without the status guard in SQL (relies on can.dispute from a prior read): race-prone. Add 'AND status IN (paid,delivered)' to the UPDATE.
postMessage(deliver) inserts the delivery message before the guarded status UPDATE; with concurrent requests a second delivery message can be added. Wrap it in a tx or check affectedRows.
leaveReview relies on the reviews.order_id unique key (if present) to stop double reviews in a race. Verify that the unique index exists.
admin/$section.tsx is fine in size (289 lines). The orders.$id page is used by buyer, seller and admin roles; keep the role checks server-side, as is done now.

success_rate.backend: 88% (8/8 pytest passed; 2 critical functional gaps: logout cookies, i18n)
success_rate.frontend: ~85% of requested flows pass; logout and i18n fail

seed_data_creation: Orders #7 (buyer1->KeyForge, completed + 4-star TEST_ review, review id 7), #8 (cancelled by admin), #9 (buyer2->PixelVault, delivered manually then completed), #10 (buyer2->PixelVault, disputed then refunded by admin). Offer #41 'TEST_ Steam Wallet 20 USD code' (PixelVault, now paused, 2 options). Payout #1 $4.00 PixelVault (marked paid). Seller reply on review for order 3. Order payments were simulated with signed Stripe webhooks (STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SECRET). Test signup user and failed login_attempts were deleted.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Login form: scope fields inside [data-testid=login-form] (the register form also has field-email/field-password). To log out in tests, use context.clear_cookies() until logout is fixed. Card payment on checkout.stripe.com could not be automated (Link UI). Mark Stripe orders paid with the signed webhook in test_juj_payments_webhook.py (it picks the newest pending stripe order). Server-fn ids are base64 of {file, export}, e.g. loginFn_createServerFn_handler; the body uses seroval format (see the curl in this run). Admin actions use native confirm/prompt: add page.on('dialog', accept). Release on a paid order was not exercised (no paid order left); Refund and Cancel were.
rca of the issue: Collation: mysql2 charset 'utf8mb4' => collation id 45 utf8mb4_general_ci on the connection. CAST(o.id AS CHAR) has the connection collation and is compared with content_translations.entity_id (utf8mb4_unicode_ci) => ER_CANT_AGGREGATE_2COLLATIONS. Fixed by setting charset UTF8MB4_UNICODE_CI. Logout: reproduced with curl against localhost:3000 — the login server-fn response contains only 'set-cookie: juj_rt=...', and logout contains only the juj_rt deletion. Both setCookie calls run, but only the final header is written (TanStack Start dev/SSR pipeline collapses multiple Set-Cookie headers). Mitigation: use one cookie, or a single Set-Cookie per response.
